worldcombat.skill.metalburst.summary: Blasts the most recent damage taken out from the user at 1.5x: the chosen target takes the full sum only if it is inside the circle with clear line of sight, other foes inside take a share, those behind a wall take nothing, capped at the user's maximum health; with no debt the blast only clanks.
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.use.0: Erupt after a hit to punish a close pack
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.use.1: Shave a whole melee down with the blast
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.use.2: Turn damage taken into area damage
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.description: The last blow recorded on the ledger is blasted out of the body for about %1$s refund damage; only the most recent hit taken within the last %2$s stays on the ledger (each new hit overwrites it), physical or special alike. With no debt to collect it only clanks.

Explodes centred on the user, radius %1$s blocks, hitting at most %2$s enemies; the chosen target takes the full sum only if it is inside the circle with clear line of sight, every other enemy inside takes %3$s each, and those behind a wall take nothing. The refund never exceeds %4$s of the user's maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.shrapnel.on: Shrapnel mode on: nearby foes take a larger share, but the aimed target's sum drops to 80%, with 2 more ticks of prepare and 8 more of cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.shrapnel.of: Shrapnel mode off: nearby foes take a smaller share, putting the whole stress on the aimed target.
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.timing: Castable on an enemy or an empty point within %1$s blocks (the blast is always centred on the user); commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.growth.0: At level %1$s the blast radius grows to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.growth.1: At level %1$s the blast radius grows to %2$s blocks and the refund cap rises to %3$s.
On: nearby foes take a larger share (70% of the refund each), but the aimed target's sum drops to 80%, with 2 more ticks of prepare and 8 more of cooldown. Off: nearby foes take a smaller share (45%), putting the whole stress on the aimed target.
Only chase the debtor within this distance to detonate; a larger value pursues the debt further.
